name: Mahoutsukai to Tenshi to Akuma
original_name: 魔法使いと天使と悪魔
source:
When Lucil's home is attacked by a violent mob, his grandfather teleports him to safety. Burned and battered, Lucil is aware of two beings standing over him: one of Light, and one of Darkness.

Which hand will he take? What fate awaits him when he chooses?

[From [url=https://jast.blue/detail/sorcerers-choice-angel-or-demon]JAST Blue[/url]]
translation:
当卢西尔的家遭到暴徒袭击时，祖父将他传送到安全之处。卢西尔浑身烧伤、遍体鳞伤，意识到有两个存在站在自己身旁：一个来自光明，一个来自黑暗。

他会握住哪只手？选择之后等待他的又是什么命运？

[来源：[url=https://jast.blue/detail/sorcerers-choice-angel-or-demon]JAST Blue[/url]]
